questions.question: The man ______ is standing at the gate is my teacher.
questions.explanation: 先行词为人且在从句中作主语，用who。

questions.question: I will never forget the day ______ I first met you.
This is the best film ______ I have ever seen.
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级修饰，用that。

questions.question: He has two sons, both of ______ are doctors.
Which of the following can be used to introduce an attributive clause?
questions.explanation: 四个词均可引导定语从句。

questions.question: The book ______ cover is red is mine.
The relative pronoun 'that' can refer to both people and things.
Combine the sentences: The girl is my sister. She is wearing a red dress.
questions.answer: The girl who/that is wearing a red dress is my sister.

questions.question: Could you tell me ______ you will go to Beijing?
I don't know ______ he will come tomorrow.
He asked me ______ I could help him.
I wonder ______ he said at the meeting.
Which words can introduce an object clause?
questions.explanation: 四个词均可引导宾语从句。

questions.question: I believe ______ he is honest.
questions.explanation: that引导陈述句作宾语从句。

questions.question: Object clauses must use statement word order.
Change to object clause: 'Is he coming?' She asked.
questions.answer: She asked if/whether he was coming.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句变宾语从句用if/whether。

questions.question: ______ it rains heavily, we will stay at home.
______ he is young, he knows a lot.
I was reading ______ he was watching TV.
questions.explanation: while表示对比，连接两个延续性动作。

questions.question: Hardly had I arrived home ______ it began to rain.
Which can introduce an adverbial clause of time?
questions.explanation: 四词均可引导时间状语从句。

questions.question: I won't leave ______ you come back.
'If' can introduce a conditional clause.
Combine: He didn't go to bed. He finished his homework.
questions.answer: He didn't go to bed until he had finished his homework.

questions.question: He enjoys ______ books in his free time.
I decided ______ a letter to him.
______ in the sun is bad for your eyes.
The book ______ on the desk is mine.
Which verbs are followed by gerunds?
He made me ______ (laugh).
questions.explanation: make sb. do sth. 使役动词接省略to的不定式。

questions.question: 'To do' can be used as the subject of a sentence.
Rewrite using a gerund: It is important that we protect the environment.
完形填空: Tom is a middle school student. He ______ to school every day.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时，主语为第三人称单数。

questions.question: 完形填空: She ______ English for three years.
完形填空: If I ______ you, I would accept the offer.
完形填空: The children ______ playing football when it began to rain.
questions.explanation: when引导的时间状语从句，主句用过去进行时。

questions.question: 完形填空: By the time we got there, the film ______.
questions.explanation: by the time+过去时，主句用过去完成时。

questions.question: 阅读理解: Li Ming usually gets up at 6:30. What time does he get up?
阅读理解: The passage mainly tells us about ______.
阅读理解: What does the underlined word 'abandon' mean?
questions.explanation: abandon意为'放弃、抛弃'，与leave意思最接近。

questions.question: 阅读理解: According to the passage, which statements are true?
options: B. Exercise is good for health.

questions.question: 阅读理解: What is the writer's purpose in writing this passage?
questions.answer: To encourage students to read more books.
